skill_name: Research and briefly summarize the political views of Gandhi.
workflow: Mahatma Gandhi, India's spiritual leader, was a proponent of nonviolent civil disobedience as a path to achieving political change. He prized civil disobedience as a form of power, believing that it could bring about far-reaching social and political reform without bloodshed. He rejected violence, imperialism, and colonialism and was strongly opposed to the presence of the British in India. He also advocated for economic self-sufficiency and saw religious unity and harmony as necessary for India
